subject: dec
title: DEC.------C.ACT.
description: Second diagram on page 349, paired with the (R)DYM-F × PRI-INFO crossing above it. Where the first diagram structurally shows how alternative-recording's dynamic-functionalism reaches affinity-insight through ALT-D, this one names the political condition that makes that routing possible: (R)DEC (the reality of decentralization — the move the section's prose calls 'breaking the dominance that certain sectors of the planet now enjoy') is crossed with C-ACT (composite activism — the organized collective doing of decentralization). C-ACT appears only in the title; no C-ACT label is drawn. DEC sits on the left with the subject-arrow; DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) hangs immediately below as the decentralization subject's primary output. EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) branches from the DYM-F line, and PHY-U-P (the physical-universe particulars) rises from the EXP-INFO-B line. (R)POST (the reality of postulation) branches from EXP-INFO-B and carries POL-DY (political dynamics) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). (C)INDIV-TD (the concept of individual tendencies) and SPI-GH (spiritual growth) branch from AF-DY, and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) hangs from the SPI-GH line.
